collection.title: Škoda Karoq 2021 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Skoda Karoq 2021-2023 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
